  while (true) {

=== r5_ok_rust_deadline rs -
async fn wait_ready() {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + WAIT;
    loop {
        if ready().await { break; }
        if Instant::now() > deadline { return; }
        sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
    }
}

=== r5_ok_periodic rs -
async fn ticker() {
    loop {
        sleep(PERIOD).await;
        refresh().await;
    }
}

=== r5_ok_ts_signal ts -
export async function waitReady(signal: AbortSignal) {
  while (true) {
    if (signal.aborted || (await ready())) return;
    await sleep(100);
  }
}
